plaster noun

classical

tēctōrium, tēctōriī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

plaster, plaster coating

Palladius discusses applying and levelling it.

Examples

  • Tēctōrium parietī indūcunt.

    They are applying plaster to the wall.composed

  • tēctōrium parietī indūcere

    to plaster a wallTraupman 168

See also plasterer, lime, mortar.
